summary: Per-frame update for a game object: optionally registers the object in a tracking list, runs a float timer countdown that triggers an expired-state transition plus a vtable callback, then runs two physics sub-updates and two trailing vtable callbacks. Returns 0.

local_names.v2: remaining timer value after the countdown
local_names.obj: sub-object reached via this+0x40 (list node and float field source)

operations.description: If the DWORD flag at this+0xE8 is non-zero, register the object in a tracking list.
DoublyLinkedListAppend_6750(*(this+0x40), this, 0) appends the object; the node pointers live in the sub-object at *(this+0x40) at offsets 0xA8 and 0xAC.
If the float timer at this+0x124 is >= 0.0, run the countdown.
v2 = *(float*)(this+0x124) - FloatFieldAccessor(*(this+0x40)): subtract the sub-object float field 0x2C from the timer.
Write the decremented value v2 back to the timer at this+0x124.
If the decremented timer v2 has gone below 0.0, run the expiry path.
FieldSetterCall(*(this+0x40), 1) sets a state field on the sub-object, marking the timer as expired.
Virtual dispatch at vtable offset 172 (0xAC) on the this object's vtable (this+0x0).
If either flag byte at this+0xF4 or this+0xF5 is set, run the primary sub-update.
sub_466350(this) runs the conditional position/velocity sub-update.
sub_466650(this) runs the secondary physics sub-update unconditionally.
Virtual dispatch at vtable offset 44 (0x2C) with arguments (this, 1).
Virtual dispatch at vtable offset 168 (0xA8) on the this object's vtable.
